thread.title: Cirrus Logic: A Relief Rally for This Apple Supplier? - Barron's

title: Cirrus Logic: A Relief Rally for This Apple Supplier? - Barron's
text:
Tiernan Ray Updated April 30, 2018 4:01 p.m. ET
Cirrus Logic ( CRUS ) shares have had quite a rough 2018, falling 29% this year so far, as estimates for its biggest customers, Apple ( AAPL ), continue to trend lower and lower for the iPhone.
Enough is enough , writes Anthony Stoss of Craig-Hallum Capital today, as he revises his rating on the stock to Buy from Hold, while trimming his price target by a buck to $43.
Following the company’s earnings report on Wednesday afternoon, after the closing bell, “we think shares could see a rally” on investor relief, he writes.
Apple accounts for 80% of Cirrus revenue, making this chip company one of the best tracking stocks, if you will, for Apple products aside from Apple itself.
Stoss draws some encouragement from the report last Thursday of Apple supplier Knowles ( KN ), which missed expectations but whose shares rallied by 11% the next day:
We highlight Apple supplier KN was trading at a sub-12x P/E before their earnings report last Thursday AMC (4/26/18) as shares had sold off 30%+ since January on Apple worries. Following KN’s roughly in line results/guide, shares rallied 15%+ as we think Apple was already priced in. We believe a similar event may take place for CRUS and with shares trading sub-10x based on our new FY20 (March) EPS estimate of $3.80, shares should trade closer to an 11x P/E or ~$43. We are therefore upgrading to Buy and lowering our price target to $43.
Cirrus stock today is up 37 cents, or 1%, at $36.57. Apple stock is up $3.08, or 1.9%, at $165.40.
